title: [CLM-5] Replaceability is not backed for a relay added mid-life of a group
description: Review finding CLM-5: Replaceability is not backed for a relay added mid-life of a group (lens CLM). Location: spec/10-relays.md:612-622; ARCHITECTURE.md:106-109 (S5). Fix: 10.5.1 registers only "the group's first-epoch access public key" and then "the Relay follows the chain". Nothing lets a new relay pick up a live chain, and grep finds no relay-replacement procedure in 10 or 11. Allow `AccessChainRegistration` at the current `epoch` with that epoch's `channelToken` and access key (the format already has `epoch`), signed by the same billing DID. The registration service holds those values because it countersigned the announcement. Require the CO to register live chains at a new relay before switching. This keeps Q6's trust model (same service, same billing key) and is required by S5, which governs on conflict. Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.2 Channel Admission (Rotation): "When the CO enters into or renews a ServiceAgreement, it registers the current key with that IO"; CO-issued admission key replaces the chain (decision B)
